overview: The council conducted a comprehensive review of the administration's decision to switch EMS providers from Armstrong to Cataldo, ultimately requesting a pause in the transition and more data. The body also revised the City Clerk recruitment process and tabled a compensation ordinance.

items.title: Ambulance EMS Contract Negotiation and Transition
items.summary: Requested the Mayor pause the EMS transition to Cataldo and approved data requests regarding response times and contract payments following conflicting reports of performance and fiscal compliance. The administration alleged Armstrong failed to meet reporting and payment obligations, while Armstrong representatives defended their service record and cited legal concerns over the city's invoicing process.

items.title: Standard Compensation Ordinance
items.summary: Tabled the standard compensation ordinance to a future committee meeting.

items.title: City Clerk Recruitment and Hiring Process
items.summary: Approved reposting the City Clerk position without minimum requirements through February 6, 2026, and expanded the advertising range to the MMA and Master List job boards. The human resources department raised concerns regarding the equity of removing entrance requirements for new applicants after previously vetting a pool of candidates.
